# LaplandWeddings

> Destination weddings in Finnish Lapland: Northern Lights ceremonies, snow chapels, ice hotels and midnight sun celebrations.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laplandweddings.online/): Weddings in Finnish Lapland
- [Wedding types](https://laplandweddings.online/wedding-types/): Northern Lights, snow chapel, glass igloo, midnight sun, elopement and vow renewal
- [Venues](https://laplandweddings.online/venues/): Wedding venues across Lapland
- [Locations](https://laplandweddings.online/locations/): Rovaniemi, Levi, Ylläs, Saariselkä and more
- [Photographers](https://laplandweddings.online/photographers/): Wedding photographers in Lapland
- [Practical guide](https://laplandweddings.online/practical-guide/): Practical planning information
- [Pricing](https://laplandweddings.online/pricing/): Wedding planning services
- [DVV checklist for foreign couples](https://laplandweddings.online/checklist/dvv-foreign-couples/): Marriage paperwork in Finland

## Languages

English (default), Finnish (/fi/), Swedish (/sv/), German (/de/), French (/fr/), Spanish (/es/), Italian (/it/), Dutch (/nl/), Japanese (/ja/), Brazilian Portuguese (/br/), Chinese (/cn/), Korean (/kr/)
